profile.headline: Data & Asset-Driven Solutions | Data Store Management | Digital Asset Management | Work Flow Automation | Complex Problem Solving
profile.summary: Accomplished and versatile technology leader with a proven ability to dissect complex problems and deliver effective solutions employing data store design and management, data and media-driven applications, and workflow automation. Expert in fostering collaboration between diverse cross-functional teams, managing stakeholder expectations, innovative problem-solving, and optimizing workflows and operations with a dedication to driving excellence and efficiency.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, managed, and administered Postgres and Redis data stores for in-house applications.
• Built an automated employee and asset records auditing system, which enabled quarterly audits, strengthened security protocols, and improved asset management and reporting efficiency. 
• Maintained and extended a web-based interface to Pixar's LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) used to manage accounts and assets, allowing authorized staff to perform all CRUD operations on LDAP records.
• Created an API (Application Programming Interface) for Pixar's web-based interface to LDAP, "LDAP-Tools," allowing other programs to programmatically perform bulk create, update, or clean-up LDAP records. 
• Modernized a legacy work request system by porting it from Ruby on Rails to Python running on Django, adding an API and tests, upgrading the Postgres database, and automating the setup process with Ansible, reducing setup time by 90% and enhancing maintainability and security.
• Utilized Python, Flask, Ruby on Rails, Django, Vue, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Rancher to deliver robust software solutions to replace legacy applications, manual builds, processes and workflows.
• Automated building project infrastructure and the setup of development environments, testing, and deployment processes using Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, and Ansible, improving efficiency by 90%.

Technologies used daily include:  Postgres, PostgreSQL, Unix, Bash, Git, Kubernetes, Vault, Terraform, Ansible, Rancher, Python, Flask, Django, Ruby on Rails, Vue, JQuery, NGINX, Apache and Gunicorn.
positions.insights: Project Management, Automated Software Testing and +17 skills

positions.title: Programmer IV / Bibliographic Databases Coordinator
positions.description:
• Managed the Integrated Library System, Aleph, supporting all library functions.
• Automated workflows and reporting for circulation, reserves, acquisitions, and cataloging, streamlining library operations and saving approximately $100K.
• Reconciled the annual library budget audit delivered by the the library's ILS (Integrated Library System), Aleph, to the manual audit by resolving discrepancies within two years of acquisitions records in Aleph, and implemented solutions within Aleph to ensure accurate future audits.
positions.insights: Reporting & Analysis, Digital Asset Management and +4 skills

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
• Supported digital initiatives by providing programming support for a home-grown digital asset management system (DAMS), encoding documents to a machine-readable format, establishing best practices, and documenting procedures.  Examples include the United Farm Workers Collection, British Women Romantic Poets 1789-1832 Collection, and Folk Literature of the Sephardic Jewish People. 
• Developed and maintained the Shields Library and Digital Initiatives websites.
positions.insights: Data Store Design & Management, LAMP (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP) and +7 skills

positions.title: Binding Services Unit Head / Library Assistant
positions.description:
• Led the Binding Services unit by managing personnel and the department budget, training student employees, overseeing in-house binding operations, and preparing bi-weekly shipments to the external UC bindery.
• Assisted in Preservation of library material using manual and digital preservation solutions.
• Enhanced productivity and timely work completion in the Binding Services unit by boosting employee attendance and motivation through strategic raises and clear communication.
• Repaired and maintained legacy binding equipment, sourcing parts creatively, and mastering repair techniques.
positions.insights: Employee Training, People Management and +4 skills

skills.name: Workflow & Build Automation (Ansible, Git CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, Vault)
Programming Languages (SQL, PostgreSQL, Python, Ruby (on Rails), PHP)
Process & Build Automation (Ansible, Git CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, Vault)
Tools & Technologies (Apache, NGINX, Gunicorn, Git, Rancher)
